medium_confidence_findings.evidence: FOUR OAKS CARE SERVICES is committed to long-range planning to ensure service continuity and, therefore, to a formal and periodic risk management process as a method to identify loss exposures, analyze and evaluate loss exposures. Identify a strategy to be taken to counter any potential loss, implement the most effective strategy, provide ongoing management/governance oversight of the efficacy of decisions made regarding risk management/loss prevention activities, and implement any necessary changes as may be indicated by a changing service and/or business environment.
medium_confidence_findings.description: The provided text describes a commitment to risk management but lacks specific details about the implementation and documentation of the risk management process. It mentions identifying, analyzing, and evaluating loss exposures, but doesn't specify how often this is done, who is responsible, or how the results are documented and used to inform decision-making.
medium_confidence_findings.recommendation: Develop and document a comprehensive risk management plan that includes the frequency of risk assessments, roles and responsibilities, documentation procedures, and how the results are used to inform decision-making and improve service delivery. Ensure the plan addresses all relevant areas of operation.
